subject: Film & Cinema
title: Camera Movement and Meaning
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Camera Movement and Meaning.

hook.text: A still camera feels observational. A moving camera feels alive. Movement has meaning.

buildup.text: Pans survey a space. Tracking shots follow a character. Crane shots reveal scale.

discovery.text: Steadicam freed the camera to glide through spaces — The Shining's hallway shot changed cinema.

twist.text: Excessive camera movement can feel gimmicky. The best movements are invisible to the audience.

climax.text: When the camera moves with purpose, the audience feels without thinking.

punchline.text: Every camera movement is a sentence.

quiz.question: What technology enabled The Shining's famous hallway shots?
